Do not penalize the general accounting principle or require a numerical balance. A definite issuer-specific zero for all related liabilities requires evidence not supplied here. Full dimension credit also requires warranted stakeholder analysis.

scoring_guidance.recognition: Full credit for the recognition component includes correctly stating that a carrying liability cannot be established from the supplied evidence. Unknown is neither zero nor proof of nonrecognition. Unsupported zero or unrecorded-liability assertions receive no credit for that component and count as material unsupported assertions. Full dimension credit also requires warranted stakeholder analysis.
scoring_guidance.citations: Conventional primary filing, note or section citations and internal document/locator IDs are equally acceptable when semantically supporting the claim. Internal schema IDs are not required. Fabricated citations earn no grounding credit for the associated claim.
scoring_guidance.presentation: Score semantic correctness independently of headings, organization, prose or bullets, and guided-prompt terminology.
